Hero.title: 50 Years Supporter FC Meilen
Hero.subtitle: A community of passion and tradition since 1976.

Intro.headline: Through victories and defeats, our community stood together on the terraces.
Intro.p1: Founded by a handful of devoted fans sharing a profound love for the game and their hometown, Supporter FC Meilen has grown into a cornerstone of local football culture. What began over a few beers post-match has evolved into a half-century legacy.
Intro.p2: From coordinating our first away-day trips in the late 70s to organizing massive choreographies in the modern era, our spirit remains unchanged: unconditional support.

HistoryPage.title: 50 Years of History
HistoryPage.subtitle: A half-century of passion, loyalty, and local tradition.
HistoryPage.foundationDesc: In the 70s, it all began with a group of friends who wanted to be more than just spectators. They wanted to be the soul of the club.
HistoryPage.milestone1Desc: From promotion to relegation, we stayed. Our colors fly proudly in every stadium.
HistoryPage.milestone2Desc: The introduction of our first major choreographies marked a turning point in Swiss fan culture.
HistoryPage.milestone3Desc: Today we celebrate not just a club, but a family that has existed since 1976.

About.title: Against Modern Football
About.subtitle: We stand for tradition, local pride, and 90 minutes of unconditional vocal support.
About.foundationDesc1: In autumn 1976, a group of friends stood in the rain behind the goal, watching Meilen lose a close match. Instead of leaving, they began to sing. That moment—standing together despite the weather and the score—became the origin of a movement that lives on to this day.
About.foundationDesc2: For five decades, the Supporters Association of FC Meilen has been the beating heart of our stadium. We are not just fans – we are the 12th man. With our membership contributions, we specifically support the youth department and the club: we help with football camps, organize tournaments, provide financial contributions for kits, and also support the club administratively. Together, we ensure that local football in Meilen is sustainably promoted and continues to thrive.
About.solidarityDesc1: FC Meilen is more than a game – it is unity, identity, and family. As the Supporters Association of FC Meilen, we actively promote the community: through youth tournaments, support for social projects, and local engagement.
About.solidarityDesc2: We believe in real football – approachable, honest, and for everyone. That is why we stand against excessive commercialization and advocate for everyone in Meilen to have the opportunity to be part of this club and this community.
About.pillar1Desc: Through the leagues, through the decades. We never leave early.
About.pillar2Desc: Self-funded, self-organized. We owe nothing to modern sponsors.
About.pillar3Desc: Loud singing, pyrotechnics, and absolute dedication to the colors.

president.title: Our President
president.name: Dr. Sanji Lingam
president.bio: Youth development is an investment in the future of our club.Together with our members and partners, we create sustainable prospects for FC Meilen.

m1.name: Slavica Jovanovic
m1.bio: Slavica Jovanovic is responsible for the financial management of the Supporters' Association. With precision and transparency, she ensures that all funds are used purposefully and responsibly for the junior teams.

m2.name: Hanspeter Huber
m2.bio: Hanspeter Huber brings years of experience and club loyalty to the board. He supports strategic projects and contributes to strengthening the community around FC Meilen.

m3.name: Wolfgang Hafner
m3.bio: Wolfgang Hafner is particularly involved in organizational and event-related topics. His commitment contributes significantly to the successful implementation of club events and anniversary projects.

m4.name: Danijela Frei
m4.bio: Danijela Frei supports the board in administrative and communicative matters. With her dedication, she strengthens the internal organization and the external presence of the Supporters' Association.
